results.content:
### Albums

Albums is like any other card collection event found in other game genres. Here you collect Card Packs from events as rewards or through special offers. Each card pack grants you stickers. Each sticker is a part of a set which is a part of the album. Players earn rewards for completing sets and albums.

There are different types of cards based on rarity.

## Monetization

Dice Dreams has a main store and many special offers active at a time.

### Main Store [...] The daily login calendar incentivizes the players to come in daily into the game. Every time a player logs in and collects a reward, the progression meter fills and has bigger gifts to be earned over time.

## Conclusion

Dice Dreams offers a fresh take on casual gameplay with its dynamic dice-rolling mechanic, visually captivating artwork, and a plethora of innovative minigames to play. It surely is an immersive journey that promises endless surprises and delightful moments for players. [...] ## Minigames

Dice Dreams has gone beyond just the Raid / Attack mechanic of CM and expanded the whole set of minigames that can be played through the Dice outcomes. It has been packaged as a card collection where these minigames can be unlocked and upgraded. Apart from the minigames, this card collection also has cards for Coin and Roll outcome which increases the coins and rolls granted through the core action of roll.
